name: Announcement Bar
description: Provides an 'Announcementbar' block that shows a dismissible site announcement banner with configurable message, CTA button, position and colors.
project_description: Announcement Bar provides a single Drupal block plugin (id 'announcementbar', admin label 'Announcementbar') that renders a site announcement banner. The block form lets an administrator set the message, a CTA button label, the fixed position (top/bottom), background and text colors, and a cookie interval/period controlling how long the bar stays dismissed after a visitor closes it. Rendering is handled by the 'announcementbar_template' theme hook; a small jQuery behavior (js/announcementbar.js) shows/hides the bar and sets a dismissal cookie. The module ships no routes, no permissions, and no config schema of its own; configuration is stored on the block config entity and it depends only on core Block.
